Francisco Golcl Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagwuahal Sl., Diliman, Ouezon City LEGAL SERVICE MAYOR BIENVENIDO P. MARGARICO Janiuay, Iloilo City Dear Mayor Margarico: DILG OPINION NO S. JUN Z S This pertains to the indorsement of Regional Director Evelyn A. Trompeta, 2010 DILG Region VI, relative to your letter-query regarding MDC Resolution No. 2 Series of 2008, requesting for legal opinion on the following questions which we quoted hereunder: "I. What wi// happen to the Annua/ Investment Plan if the Sangguniang Bayan wi// not adopt it due to some suggestions/recommendations for revisions? 2. Can the Sangguniang Bayan amend the Annual Investment Plan as to its Programs, Projects and Activities (PPAs) and a//ocations for revisions? 3. What wi// happen if the Municipa/ Development counci/ wi// not be amenable to the suggestions/recommendations of the Sangguniang Bayan?, 4. What wi// be the effect of the Sangguniang Bayan's decision for not adopting the Annua/ Investment Plan to the Municipa/ Annua/ Budget?" In reply to your queries, please be informed that this Department had the occasion to opined similar queries in DILG Opinion No. 22 Series of 2007 which states, in gist, that if the Sangguniang Bayan is not amenable to the Municipal Development Council's (MDC) approved projects and programs, the said sanggunian should instead return it to the MDC with its comments and recommendations for the LDC's proper consideration. It is also emphasized however that although the SB is authorized by the Code to approve the plans formulated by the MDC, such authority does not include the power to modify, alter or revise the same, albeit, the SB is not precluded from raising questions thereon for purposes of clarification. Attached herewith is a photocopy of DILG Opinion No. 22 series of 2007 for your ready reference. Thank you and warm regards. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: my. JESUS .
